newsitem.title: USA: NGC, Destec deal on track to close in June.
newsitem.headline: NGC, Destec deal on track to close in June.

text.p: NGC Corp's $1.3 billion acquisition of Destec Energy Inc is on track to close in June following approvals from federal regulators and Destec shareholders, NGC Chairman Chuck Watson said on Wednesday.

Higher-than-expected prices on non-strategic Destec assets to be sold off after the closing will lower NGC's net cost of the acquisition once the deal is completed, Watson said at the company's annual meeting here.
"It's about $300 million net to NGC now," Watson said of NGC's net cost of the acquisition, down from initial estimates of $400 million net to NGC when the deal was announced.

After the deal closes, NGC will complete the planned sale of Destec's international assets and operations to AES Corp and the sale of a 220 megawatt power plant to Florida Power Corp, among other things.
In the deal, NGC will retain Destec's 1,800 megawatts of generating capacity from 20 U.S. power plants largely in California and Texas, he said.

The company has no new deals in the works and is focused on integrating recent acquisitions, including its merger with the Chevron Corp natural gas and Warren Petroleum Co natural gas liquids businesses, Watson said.
